meta_data.base_class: Predict the revenue of a specific <industry-specific company> over a defined time period - refers to a business entity operating within a specific industry sector, for which financial projections can be made based on trends and past performance.

tool_template.name: predict_<class>_revenue
tool_template.description: Predict the revenue of a <class> for a specific period based on historical data.

period.description: The period for which revenue is to be predicted.

industry_trends.description: Whether to consider trends of the <class> in prediction.

historical_data_years.description: The number of past years of data to consider for predicting the <class> revenue.

economic_indicators.description: Whether to include economic indicators like GDP growth and unemployment rate in the prediction for the <class>.

prediction_confidence_interval.description: The confidence interval for the revenue prediction, providing a range of uncertainty for the <class> revenue forecast.

include_seasonality.description: Whether to account for seasonal fluctuations in revenue for the <class>.
